message: Build a 15m by 2.5m parallel-chord Pratt truss with five equal panels. Put top and bottom nodes at x=0, 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15m, with a vertical at every panel line. Add diagonals from top 0m to bottom 3m, top 3m to bottom 6m, top 6m to bottom 9m, bottom 9m to top 12m, and bottom 12m to top 15m. Use a pinned support at the left bottom node and a horizontal roller free in global X at the right bottom node. Apply 10kN downward at each of the four interior top nodes and run static analysis.
